Hazrat Hatib bin Abi Balta'ah R.A ke bare mein is surat ki shuru ki aayatein nazil hui hain, waqia yeh huwa ke Hazrat Hatib Muhajirin mein se the, Badr ki larakhi mein bhi aap ne musalmanon ke lashkar mein shirkat ki thi, unke baal bachche aur maal o daulat Makkah mein hi the aur yeh khud Quraysh se na the, sirf Hazrat Usman R.A ke halif the is wajah se Makkah mein unhein amn hasil tha. Ab yeh Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath Madina Sharif mein the yahan tak ke jab Ahl-e-Makkah ne ahd tor diya aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ne un par charhai karna chahi to aap ki khwahish yeh thi ke unhein achanak daboch lein taake khoonrezi na hone paye aur Makkah Sharif par qabza ho jaye, isisi liye aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua bhi ki ke Bari Ta'ala hamari tayari ki khabrein hamare pahunchne tak Ahl-e-Makkah ko na pahunchein. Idhar aap ne musalmanon ko tayari ka hukum diya, Hazrat Hatib R.A ne is mauqa par ek khat Ahl-e-Makkah ke naam likha aur ek Qurayshiyah aurat ke hath use chalta kiya, jismein Rasool Allah ﷺ ke is irade aur musalmanon ki lashkar kashi ki khabar darj thi. Aap ka irada isse sirf yeh tha ke mera koi ehsan Quraysh par reh jaye, jiske bais mere baal bachche aur maal-o-daulat mehfooz rahein. Chunke Huzoor ﷺ ki dua qabul ho chuki thi aur namumkin tha ke Qurayshiyon ko kisi zariye se bhi is irade ka ilm ho jaye, isliye Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ﷺ ko is poshida raaz se muttala farma diya aur aap ne us aurat ke piche apne sawar bheje, raste mein use roka gaya aur khat usse hasil kar liya gaya. Yeh mufassal waqia sahih ahadidis mein poori tarah aa chuka hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain: Mujhe, Hazrat Zubair R.A aur Hazrat Miqdad R.A ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ne bulwa kar farmaya: Tum yahan se foran koch karo, Rauza-e-Khakh mein jab tum pahuncho ge to tumhein ek sandni sawar aurat milegi, jiske paas ek khat hai, tum use qabza mein kar ke yahan le aao. Hum teeno ghodon par sawar ho kar bahut tez raftari se rawanah ho gaye, Rauza-e-Khakh mein jab pahunche to fi-waqia humein ek sandni sawar aurat dikhai di, hum ne usse kaha ke jo khat tere paas hai woh hamare hawale kar. Usne saf inkar kar diya ke mere paas koi khat nahi hai. Hum ne kaha: Ghalat kehti hai, tere paas yaqinan khat hai, agar tu raazi khushi na degi to hum jama talashi kar ke jabran woh khat tujhse chhein ge. Ab to woh عورت (aurat) sat-patai aur akhir us ne apni choti khol kar us mein se woh parcha nikal kar hamare hawale kiya. Hum usi waqt wahan se wapas rawanah hue aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein use pesh kar diya. Parhne par maloom huwa ke Hazrat Hatib R.A ne use likha hai aur yahan ki khabar rasani ki hai. Huzoor ﷺ ke iradon se Kuffar-e-Makkah ko aagah kiya hai. Aap ne kaha: Hatib! Yeh kya harkat hai?

Hazrat Hatib R.A ne farmaya Rasulullah ﷺ jaldi na kijiye meri bhi sun lijiye, main Quraishiyon mein mila hua tha khud Quraishiyon mein se na tha par Aap par iman la kar Aap ke sath hijrat ki jitne aur Muhajirin hain un sab ke qarabat-dar Makkah mein maujood hain jo un ke baal-bache waghera Makkah mein reh gaye hain woh un ki himayat karte hain lekin mera koi rishta-dar nahi jo mere bachon ki hifazat kare is liye maine chaha ki Quraishiyon ke sath koi sulook-o-ehsan karun jis se mere bachon ki hifazat woh karein aur jis tarah auron ke nasab ki wajah se un ka talluq hai mere ehsan ki wajah se mera talluq ho jaye. Ya Rasulullah ﷺ maine koi kufr nahi kiya na apne deen se murtad hua hoon na Islam ke baad kufr se raazi hua hoon bas is khat ki wajah se sirf apne bachon ki hifazat ka heela tha, An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya logon tum se jo waqia Hatib bayan karte hain woh bilkul harf-ba-harf sacha hai ki apne nafa ki khatir ek galti kar baithe hain na ki musalmanon ko nuqsan pahunchana ya kuffar ki madad karna un ke pesh-e-nazar ho, Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A is mauqa par maujood thay aur yeh waqiat Aap ke samne hue Aap ko bahut gussa aaya aur farmane lage ya Rasulullah ﷺ mujhe ijazat dijiye ki is munafiq ki gardan uda doon Aap ne farmaya tumhein kya maloom nahi? ke yeh Badri Sahabi hain aur Badr walon par Allah Ta'ala ne jhankaka aur farmaya jo chaho amal karo main ne tumhein bakhsh diya, yeh riwayat aur bhi bahut si hadith ki kitabon mein hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif Kitab Al-Maghazi mein itna aur bhi hai ki phir Allah Ta'ala ne yeh surat utari aur Kitab Al-Tafseer mein hai ki Hazrat Amr R.A ne farmaya isi bare mein ayat (tarjumah) Al-Kh, utri lekin rawi ko shak hai ki ayat ke utarne ka bayan Hazrat Amr R.A ka hai ya hadith mein hai, Imam Ali bin Madini Rehimahullah farmate hain Hazrat Sufyan Rehimahullah se pucha gaya ki yeh ayat isi mein utri hai?

To Sufyan ne farmaya yeh logon ki baat mein nahi hai maine ise Amr R.H se hifz kiya hai aur ek harف bhi nahi chhoda aur mera khayal hai ke mere siwa kisi aur ne ise hifz bhi nahi rakha, Bukhari Muslim ki ek riwayat mein Hazrat Miqdad R.A ke naam ke badle Hazrat Abu Murtad R.A ka naam hai is mein yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh bhi bata diya tha ke us aurat ke pas Hazrat Hatib R.A ka khat hai, us aurat ki sawari ko bitha kar uske inkar par harchand tatola gaya lekin koi parcha hath na laga akhir jab hum ajiz aa gaye aur kahin se parcha na mila toh hum ne us aurat se kaha ke is mein toh mutlaq shak nahi ke tere pas parcha hai go hamein nahi milta lekin tere pas hai zaroor, yeh namumkin hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki baat ghalat ho ab agar tu nahi deti toh hum tere kapde utaar kar tatolenge, jab usne dekh liya ke inhein pata yaqeen hai aur yeh liye baghair na talenge toh usne apna sar khol kar apne baalon mein se parcha nikaal kar hamein de diya hum ise lekar wapas khidmat-e-Nabawi ﷺ mein hazir hue, Hazrat Umar R.A yeh waqiya sun kar farmaya usne Allah, uske Rasool ﷺ ki aur musalmanon ki khyanat ki mujhe is ki gardan marne ki ijazat dijiye, Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hatib R.A se دریافت kiya aur unhon ne woh jawab diya jo upar guzar chuka aap ne sab se farma diya ke inhein kuch na kaho aur Hazrat Umar R.A se bhi woh farmaya jo pehle bayan huwa ke Badri Sahaba mein se hain jin ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne jannat wajib kar di hai jise sun kar Hazrat Umar R.A ro diye aur farmane lage Allah ko aur uske Rasool ﷺ ko hi kamil ilm hai, yeh hadith in alfaaz se Sahih Bukhari Kitab-ul-Maghazi mein Ghazwa-e-Badr ke zikr mein hai aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne apne Makkah jaane ka irada apne chand ham-raaz Sahaba-e-Kibar R.A ke samne toh zahir kiya tha jin mein Hazrat Hatib R.A bhi thay baaqi aam taur par mashhoor tha ke Khaibar ja rahe hain, is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum khat ko sare saman mein tatol chuke aur na mila toh Hazrat Abu Murtad R.A ne kaha shayad uske pas koi parcha hi nahi is par Hazrat Ali R.A ne farmaya namumkin hai na Rasool Allah ﷺ jhoot bol sakte hain na hum ne jhoot kaha, jab hum ne ise dhamkaya toh usne hum se kaha tumhein Allah ka khauf nahi ? kya tum musalman nahi ? ek riwayat mein hai ke usne parcha apne jism mein se nikala.

Hazrat Umar R.A ke farman mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya yeh Badr mein maujud toh zarur the lekin ahd-shikani ki aur dushmanon mein hamari khabar-rasani ki aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh aurat Qabila Muzaina ki aurat thi, baaz kehte hain iska naam Sarah tha aur dushmanon mein hamari khabar-rasani ki aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh aurat Qabila Muzaina ki aurat thi, baaz kehte hain iska naam Sarah tha Aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ki azad-karda londi thi. Hazrat Hatib R.A ne isay kuch dena kiya tha aur isne apne balon tale kagaz rakh kar upar se sar gundh liya tha. Aap ne apne ghore-sawaron se farma diya tha ke iske paas Hatib R.A ka diya hua is mazmun ka khat hai, aasman se iski khabar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aayi thi. Banu Abu Ahmad ke halifa mein yeh aurat pakdi gayi thi, is aurat ne unse kaha tha ke tum munh pher lo main nikaal deti hoon, unhon ne munh pher liya phir isne nikaal kar hawalay kiya. Is riwayat mein Hazrat Hatib R.A ke jawab mein yeh bhi hai ke Allah ki qasam main Allah par aur uske Rasol ﷺ par iman rakhta hoon, koi taghayyur-tabaddul mere iman mein nahi hua. Aur isi baray mein is sorat ki aayatein Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke qissay ke khatam tak utrin. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is aurat ko iski ujrat ke das dirham Hazrat Hatib R.A ne diye thay, aur Huzoor ﷺ ne is khat ke hasil karne ke liye Hazrat Umar R.A aur Hazrat Ali R.A ko bheja tha aur Hajfah mein yeh mili thi.

Matlab aayaton ka yeh hai ke ae Musalmano! Mushrikeen aur kuffar ko jo Allah aur uske Rasool ﷺ aur momin bandon se larnay walay hain, jin ke dil tumhari adawat se pur hain, tumhein hargiz laeeq nahi ke unse dosti aur mohabbat, mel-milap aur apnayit rakho. Tumhein iske khilaf hukm diya gaya hai. Irshad hai (Tarjumah) Al-Kh, ae iman-daro! Yahood-o-Nasara se dosti mat gantho, woh aapas mein hi ek doosron ke dost hain, tum mein se jo bhi unse sawalat-o-mohabbat kare woh unhi mein se shumar hoga. Is mein kis qadar dant-dupat ke sath mamanat farmayi hai aur jagah hai (Tarjumah) Al-Kh, Musalmano!

In Ahl-e-Kitab aur kuffaar se dostiyan na karo jo tumhare deen ka mazaaq urate hain aur اسے khel kood samajh rahe hain agar tum mein imaan hai to Zaat-e-Bari se daro, ek aur jagah irshad hai musalmanon musalmanon ko chhor kar kafaron se dostiyan na karo kya tum chahte ho ke apne upar Allah Ta'ala ka khula ilzaam sabit karlo, ek aur jagah farmaya musalmanon ko chahiye ke apnon ke alawa kafaron se dostana na karein jo aisa karega woh Allah ki taraf se kisi cheez mein nahi haan batour dafa-ul-waqti aur bachao ke ho to aur baat hai Allah Ta'ala tumhe apne aap se dara raha hai, isi bina par Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hatib ؓ ka uzr qabul farma liya ke apne maal-o-aulad ke bachao ki khatir yeh kaam un se hogaya tha, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke hamare samne Rasoolullah ﷺ ne kai misalein bayan farmayein ek aur teen aur panch aur saat aur nau aur gyarah phir un mein se yeh tafseel sirf ek hi bayan ki baaqi sab chhor dein, farmaya ek zaeef maskeen kaum thi jis par zor-awar zalim kaum charhai kar ke aa gayi lekin Allah Ta'ala ne un kamzoron ki madad ki aur unhe apne dushman par ghalib kar diya ghalib aa kar un mein raunat sama gayi aur unhon ne un par mazalim shuru kar diye jis par Allah Ta'ala un se hamesha ke liye naraz hogaya. Phir musalmanon ko hoshyar karta hai ke tum in dushmanan-e-deen se kyun mawaddat-o-mohabbat rakhte ho ? halanki yeh tum se badsaluki karne mein kisi mauqe par kami nahi karte kya yeh taza waqia bhi tumhare zehen se hat gaya ke unhon ne tumhe balki khud Rasoolullah ﷺ ko bhi jabran watan se nikal bahir kiya aur iski koi aur wajah na thi siwaye is ke ke tumhari tauheed aur farmanbardari Rasool ﷺ un par garaan guzarti thi. Jaise aur jagah hai (tarjuma) yaani mominon se sirf is bina par mukhasmat aur dushmani hai ke woh Allah bartar buzurg par imaan rakhte hain aur jagah hai yeh log mahz is wajah se ناحق jala-watan kiye gaye ke woh kehte the hamara Rab Allah hai. Phir farmata hai agar sach much tum meri raah ke jihad ko nikle ho aur meri raza-mandi ke talib ho to hargiz in kuffaar se jo tumhare aur mere dushman hain mere deen ko aur tumhare jaan-o-maal ko nuqsaan pohncha rahe hain dostiyan na paida karo, bhala kis qadar ghalati hai ke tum un se posheeda taur par dostana rakho ? kya yeh posheedagi Allah se bhi posheeda reh sakti hai ? jo zahir-o-batin ka janne wala hai, dilon ke bhed aur nafs ke waswase bhi jis ke samne khule hue hain. Bas sun lo jo bhi in kuffaar se muwalat-o-mohabbat rakhe woh seedhi raah se bhatak jayega. Tum nahi dekh rahe ? ke in kafaron ka agar bas chale agar unhe koi mauqa mil jaye to na apne haath paon se tumhe nuqsaan pohnchane mein dareegh karein na bura kehne se apni zubanein rokein jo un ke imkaan mein hoga woh kar guzrenge balki tamam tar koshish is amr par sarf kar denge ke tumhe bhi apni tarah kaafir bana lein, pas jab ke unki androoni aur beruni dushmani ka haal tumhe ba-khubi maloom hai phir kya andher hai ?

ke tum apne dushmanon ko dost samajh rahe ho aur apni rah mein aap kaante bo rahe ho, gharz yeh hai ke musalmanon ko kafiron par aetmad karne aur un se aise gehre talluqaat rakhne aur dili mel rakhne se roka ja raha hai aur woh baatein yaad dilayi ja rahi hain jo un se alag-daigi par aamada kardein. Tumhari qaribatein aur rishtedaariyaan tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam na aayengi, agar tum Allah ko naraaz kar ke unhein khush karo aur chaho ke tumhein nafa ho ya nuqsaan hat jaye yeh bilkul khaam-khayali hai, na Allah ki taraf ke nuqsaan ko koi taal sake na us ke diye hue nafa ko koi rok sake, apne walon se un ke kufr par jis ne muwafqat ki woh barbaad hua, go rishtedaar kaisa hi ho kuch nafa nahi, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke aik shakhs ne Rasulullah ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke ya Rasulullah ﷺ mera baap kahan hai? Aap ne farmaya jahannam mein. Jab woh jaane laga to aap ne use bulaya aur farmaya sun mera baap aur tera baap dono hi jahannami hain. Yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein aur Sunan Abu Dawood mein bhi hai. Musalmano! Tumhare liye Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ mein aur un ke sathiyon mein behtareen namuna aur achhi pairavi maujood hai. Jabki un sab ne apni qaum se bar-mala keh diya ke hum tum se aur jin jin ki tum Allah ke siva ibadat karte ho un sab se bilkul bezaar hain, hum tumhare aqaid ke munkir hain jab tak tum Allah ki wahdaniyat par iman na laao hum mein tum mein hamesha ke liye adaawat-o-bughz zahir hogaya lekin Ibrahim ki itni baat to apne baap se hui thi ke main tumhare liye istighfar zaroor karunga aur tumhare liye mujhe Allah ke saamne kisi cheez ka ikhtiyar kuch bhi nahi, Aie hamare parvardigar tujh hi par hum ne bharosa kiya hai aur teri hi taraf hum rujoo karte hain aur teri hi taraf lautna hai. Aie Allah tu hamein kafiron ka zabardast aur takhta-e-mashq na bana aur aie hamare paalne wale hamari khataon ko bakhsh de, beshak tu hi ghalib hikmaton wala hai. Yaqinan tumhare liye un mein naik namuna aur umda pairavi hai khaas kar har us shakhs ke liye jo Allah ki aur Qiyamat ke din ki mulaqat ka iteqaad rakhta ho aur agar koi rogardani kare to Allah Ta'ala bilkul be-parwah hai aur woh saza-waar-e-hamd-o-sana hai.

baaqi aam taur par mashhoor tha ke Khaibar ja rahe hain, is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke jab hum khat ko sare saman mein tatol chuke aur na mila toh Hazrat Abu Murtad R.A ne kaha shayad uske pas koi parcha hi nahi is par Hazrat Ali R.A ne farmaya namumkin hai na Rasool Allah ﷺ jhoot bol sakte hain na hum ne jhoot kaha, jab hum ne ise dhamkaya toh usne hum se kaha tumhein Allah ka khauf nahi ? kya tum musalman nahi ? ek riwayat mein hai ke usne parcha apne jism mein se nikala.

Hazrat Umar R.A ke farman mein yeh bhi hai ke aap ne farmaya yeh Badr mein maujud toh zarur the lekin ahd-shikani ki aur dushmanon mein hamari khabar-rasani ki aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh aurat Qabila Muzaina ki aurat thi, baaz kehte hain iska naam Sarah tha aur dushmanon mein hamari khabar-rasani ki aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh aurat Qabila Muzaina ki aurat thi, baaz kehte hain iska naam Sarah tha Aulad-e-Abdul Muttalib ki azad-karda londi thi. Hazrat Hatib R.A ne isay kuch dena kiya tha aur isne apne balon tale kagaz rakh kar upar se sar gundh liya tha. Aap ne apne ghore-sawaron se farma diya tha ke iske paas Hatib R.A ka diya hua is mazmun ka khat hai, aasman se iski khabar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aayi thi. Banu Abu Ahmad ke halifa mein yeh aurat pakdi gayi thi, is aurat ne unse kaha tha ke tum munh pher lo main nikaal deti hoon, unhon ne munh pher liya phir isne nikaal kar hawalay kiya. Is riwayat mein Hazrat Hatib R.A ke jawab mein yeh bhi hai ke Allah ki qasam main Allah par aur uske Rasol ﷺ par iman rakhta hoon, koi taghayyur-tabaddul mere iman mein nahi hua. Aur isi baray mein is sorat ki aayatein Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke qissay ke khatam tak utrin. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke is aurat ko iski ujrat ke das dirham Hazrat Hatib R.A ne diye thay, aur Huzoor ﷺ ne is khat ke hasil karne ke liye Hazrat Umar R.A aur Hazrat Ali R.A ko bheja tha aur Hajfah mein yeh mili thi.

Matlab aayaton ka yeh hai ke ae Musalmano! Mushrikeen aur kuffar ko jo Allah aur uske Rasool ﷺ aur momin bandon se larnay walay hain, jin ke dil tumhari adawat se pur hain, tumhein hargiz laeeq nahi ke unse dosti aur mohabbat, mel-milap aur apnayit rakho. Tumhein iske khilaf hukm diya gaya hai. Irshad hai (Tarjumah) Al-Kh, ae iman-daro! Yahood-o-Nasara se dosti mat gantho, woh aapas mein hi ek doosron ke dost hain, tum mein se jo bhi unse sawalat-o-mohabbat kare woh unhi mein se shumar hoga. Is mein kis qadar dant-dupat ke sath mamanat farmayi hai aur jagah hai (Tarjumah) Al-Kh, Musalmano!

In Ahl-e-Kitab aur kuffaar se dostiyan na karo jo tumhare deen ka mazaaq urate hain aur اسے khel kood samajh rahe hain agar tum mein imaan hai to Zaat-e-Bari se daro, ek aur jagah irshad hai musalmanon musalmanon ko chhor kar kafaron se dostiyan na karo kya tum chahte ho ke apne upar Allah Ta'ala ka khula ilzaam sabit karlo, ek aur jagah farmaya musalmanon ko chahiye ke apnon ke alawa kafaron se dostana na karein jo aisa karega woh Allah ki taraf se kisi cheez mein nahi haan batour dafa-ul-waqti aur bachao ke ho to aur baat hai Allah Ta'ala tumhe apne aap se dara raha hai, isi bina par Rasoolullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hatib ؓ ka uzr qabul farma liya ke apne maal-o-aulad ke bachao ki khatir yeh kaam un se hogaya tha, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke hamare samne Rasoolullah ﷺ ne kai misalein bayan farmayein ek aur teen aur panch aur saat aur nau aur gyarah phir un mein se yeh tafseel sirf ek hi bayan ki baaqi sab chhor dein, farmaya ek zaeef maskeen kaum thi jis par zor-awar zalim kaum charhai kar ke aa gayi lekin Allah Ta'ala ne un kamzoron ki madad ki aur unhe apne dushman par ghalib kar diya ghalib aa kar un mein raunat sama gayi aur unhon ne un par mazalim shuru kar diye jis par Allah Ta'ala un se hamesha ke liye naraz hogaya. Phir musalmanon ko hoshyar karta hai ke tum in dushmanan-e-deen se kyun mawaddat-o-mohabbat rakhte ho ? halanki yeh tum se badsaluki karne mein kisi mauqe par kami nahi karte kya yeh taza waqia bhi tumhare zehen se hat gaya ke unhon ne tumhe balki khud Rasoolullah ﷺ ko bhi jabran watan se nikal bahir kiya aur iski koi aur wajah na thi siwaye is ke ke tumhari tauheed aur farmanbardari Rasool ﷺ un par garaan guzarti thi. Jaise aur jagah hai (tarjuma) yaani mominon se sirf is bina par mukhasmat aur dushmani hai ke woh Allah bartar buzurg par imaan rakhte hain aur jagah hai yeh log mahz is wajah se ناحق jala-watan kiye gaye ke woh kehte the hamara Rab Allah hai. Phir farmata hai agar sach much tum meri raah ke jihad ko nikle ho aur meri raza-mandi ke talib ho to hargiz in kuffaar se jo tumhare aur mere dushman hain mere deen ko aur tumhare jaan-o-maal ko nuqsaan pohncha rahe hain dostiyan na paida karo, bhala kis qadar ghalati hai ke tum un se posheeda taur par dostana rakho ? kya yeh posheedagi Allah se bhi posheeda reh sakti hai ? jo zahir-o-batin ka janne wala hai, dilon ke bhed aur nafs ke waswase bhi jis ke samne khule hue hain. Bas sun lo jo bhi in kuffaar se muwalat-o-mohabbat rakhe woh seedhi raah se bhatak jayega. Tum nahi dekh rahe ? ke in kafaron ka agar bas chale agar unhe koi mauqa mil jaye to na apne haath paon se tumhe nuqsaan pohnchane mein dareegh karein na bura kehne se apni zubanein rokein jo un ke imkaan mein hoga woh kar guzrenge balki tamam tar koshish is amr par sarf kar denge ke tumhe bhi apni tarah kaafir bana lein, pas jab ke unki androoni aur beruni dushmani ka haal tumhe ba-khubi maloom hai phir kya andher hai ?

ke tum apne dushmanon ko dost samajh rahe ho aur apni rah mein aap kaante bo rahe ho, gharz yeh hai ke musalmanon ko kafiron par aetmad karne aur un se aise gehre talluqaat rakhne aur dili mel rakhne se roka ja raha hai aur woh baatein yaad dilayi ja rahi hain jo un se alag-daigi par aamada kardein. Tumhari qaribatein aur rishtedaariyaan tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam na aayengi, agar tum Allah ko naraaz kar ke unhein khush karo aur chaho ke tumhein nafa ho ya nuqsaan hat jaye yeh bilkul khaam-khayali hai, na Allah ki taraf ke nuqsaan ko koi taal sake na us ke diye hue nafa ko koi rok sake, apne walon se un ke kufr par jis ne muwafqat ki woh barbaad hua, go rishtedaar kaisa hi ho kuch nafa nahi, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke aik shakhs ne Rasulullah ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke ya Rasulullah ﷺ mera baap kahan hai? Aap ne farmaya jahannam mein. Jab woh jaane laga to aap ne use bulaya aur farmaya sun mera baap aur tera baap dono hi jahannami hain. Yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein aur Sunan Abu Dawood mein bhi hai. Musalmano! Tumhare liye Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ mein aur un ke sathiyon mein behtareen namuna aur achhi pairavi maujood hai. Jabki un sab ne apni qaum se bar-mala keh diya ke hum tum se aur jin jin ki tum Allah ke siva ibadat karte ho un sab se bilkul bezaar hain, hum tumhare aqaid ke munkir hain jab tak tum Allah ki wahdaniyat par iman na laao hum mein tum mein hamesha ke liye adaawat-o-bughz zahir hogaya lekin Ibrahim ki itni baat to apne baap se hui thi ke main tumhare liye istighfar zaroor karunga aur tumhare liye mujhe Allah ke saamne kisi cheez ka ikhtiyar kuch bhi nahi, Aie hamare parvardigar tujh hi par hum ne bharosa kiya hai aur teri hi taraf hum rujoo karte hain aur teri hi taraf lautna hai. Aie Allah tu hamein kafiron ka zabardast aur takhta-e-mashq na bana aur aie hamare paalne wale hamari khataon ko bakhsh de, beshak tu hi ghalib hikmaton wala hai. Yaqinan tumhare liye un mein naik namuna aur umda pairavi hai khaas kar har us shakhs ke liye jo Allah ki aur Qiyamat ke din ki mulaqat ka iteqaad rakhta ho aur agar koi rogardani kare to Allah Ta'ala bilkul be-parwah hai aur woh saza-waar-e-hamd-o-sana hai.

Hazrat Hatib bin Abi Balta'ah R.A ke bare mein is surat ki shuru ki aayatein nazil hui hain, waqia yeh huwa ke Hazrat Hatib Muhajirin mein se the, Badr ki larakhi mein bhi aap ne musalmanon ke lashkar mein shirkat ki thi, unke baal bachche aur maal o daulat Makkah mein hi the aur yeh khud Quraysh se na the, sirf Hazrat Usman R.A ke halif the is wajah se Makkah mein unhein amn hasil tha. Ab yeh Rasool Allah ﷺ ke sath Madina Sharif mein the yahan tak ke jab Ahl-e-Makkah ne ahd tor diya aur Rasool Allah ﷺ ne un par charhai karna chahi to aap ki khwahish yeh thi ke unhein achanak daboch lein taake khoonrezi na hone paye aur Makkah Sharif par qabza ho jaye, isisi liye aap ne Allah Ta'ala se dua bhi ki ke Bari Ta'ala hamari tayari ki khabrein hamare pahunchne tak Ahl-e-Makkah ko na pahunchein. Idhar aap ne musalmanon ko tayari ka hukum diya, Hazrat Hatib R.A ne is mauqa par ek khat Ahl-e-Makkah ke naam likha aur ek Qurayshiyah aurat ke hath use chalta kiya, jismein Rasool Allah ﷺ ke is irade aur musalmanon ki lashkar kashi ki khabar darj thi. Aap ka irada isse sirf yeh tha ke mera koi ehsan Quraysh par reh jaye, jiske bais mere baal bachche aur maal-o-daulat mehfooz rahein. Chunke Huzoor ﷺ ki dua qabul ho chuki thi aur namumkin tha ke Qurayshiyon ko kisi zariye se bhi is irade ka ilm ho jaye, isliye Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ﷺ ko is poshida raaz se muttala farma diya aur aap ne us aurat ke piche apne sawar bheje, raste mein use roka gaya aur khat usse hasil kar liya gaya. Yeh mufassal waqia sahih ahadidis mein poori tarah aa chuka hai. 

Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Ali R.A farmate hain: Mujhe, Hazrat Zubair R.A aur Hazrat Miqdad R.A ko Rasool Allah ﷺ ne bulwa kar farmaya: Tum yahan se foran koch karo, Rauza-e-Khakh mein jab tum pahuncho ge to tumhein ek sandni sawar aurat milegi, jiske paas ek khat hai, tum use qabza mein kar ke yahan le aao. Hum teeno ghodon par sawar ho kar bahut tez raftari se rawanah ho gaye, Rauza-e-Khakh mein jab pahunche to fi-waqia humein ek sandni sawar aurat dikhai di, hum ne usse kaha ke jo khat tere paas hai woh hamare hawale kar. Usne saf inkar kar diya ke mere paas koi khat nahi hai. Hum ne kaha: Ghalat kehti hai, tere paas yaqinan khat hai, agar tu raazi khushi na degi to hum jama talashi kar ke jabran woh khat tujhse chhein ge. Ab to woh عورت (aurat) sat-patai aur akhir us ne apni choti khol kar us mein se woh parcha nikal kar hamare hawale kiya. Hum usi waqt wahan se wapas rawanah hue aur Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein use pesh kar diya. Parhne par maloom huwa ke Hazrat Hatib R.A ne use likha hai aur yahan ki khabar rasani ki hai. Huzoor ﷺ ke iradon se Kuffar-e-Makkah ko aagah kiya hai. Aap ne kaha: Hatib! Yeh kya harkat hai?

Hazrat Hatib R.A ne farmaya Rasulullah ﷺ jaldi na kijiye meri bhi sun lijiye, main Quraishiyon mein mila hua tha khud Quraishiyon mein se na tha par Aap par iman la kar Aap ke sath hijrat ki jitne aur Muhajirin hain un sab ke qarabat-dar Makkah mein maujood hain jo un ke baal-bache waghera Makkah mein reh gaye hain woh un ki himayat karte hain lekin mera koi rishta-dar nahi jo mere bachon ki hifazat kare is liye maine chaha ki Quraishiyon ke sath koi sulook-o-ehsan karun jis se mere bachon ki hifazat woh karein aur jis tarah auron ke nasab ki wajah se un ka talluq hai mere ehsan ki wajah se mera talluq ho jaye. Ya Rasulullah ﷺ maine koi kufr nahi kiya na apne deen se murtad hua hoon na Islam ke baad kufr se raazi hua hoon bas is khat ki wajah se sirf apne bachon ki hifazat ka heela tha, An-Hazrat ﷺ ne farmaya logon tum se jo waqia Hatib bayan karte hain woh bilkul harf-ba-harf sacha hai ki apne nafa ki khatir ek galti kar baithe hain na ki musalmanon ko nuqsan pahunchana ya kuffar ki madad karna un ke pesh-e-nazar ho, Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A is mauqa par maujood thay aur yeh waqiat Aap ke samne hue Aap ko bahut gussa aaya aur farmane lage ya Rasulullah ﷺ mujhe ijazat dijiye ki is munafiq ki gardan uda doon Aap ne farmaya tumhein kya maloom nahi? ke yeh Badri Sahabi hain aur Badr walon par Allah Ta'ala ne jhankaka aur farmaya jo chaho amal karo main ne tumhein bakhsh diya, yeh riwayat aur bhi bahut si hadith ki kitabon mein hai, Sahih Bukhari Sharif Kitab Al-Maghazi mein itna aur bhi hai ki phir Allah Ta'ala ne yeh surat utari aur Kitab Al-Tafseer mein hai ki Hazrat Amr R.A ne farmaya isi bare mein ayat (tarjumah) Al-Kh, utri lekin rawi ko shak hai ki ayat ke utarne ka bayan Hazrat Amr R.A ka hai ya hadith mein hai, Imam Ali bin Madini Rehimahullah farmate hain Hazrat Sufyan Rehimahullah se pucha gaya ki yeh ayat isi mein utri hai?

ki ek riwayat mein Hazrat Miqdad R.A ke naam ke badle Hazrat Abu Murtad R.A ka naam hai is mein yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh bhi bata diya tha ke us aurat ke pas Hazrat Hatib R.A ka khat hai, us aurat ki sawari ko bitha kar uske inkar par harchand tatola gaya lekin koi parcha hath na laga akhir jab hum ajiz aa gaye aur kahin se parcha na mila toh hum ne us aurat se kaha ke is mein toh mutlaq shak nahi ke tere pas parcha hai go hamein nahi milta lekin tere pas hai zaroor, yeh namumkin hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ki baat ghalat ho ab agar tu nahi deti toh hum tere kapde utaar kar tatolenge, jab usne dekh liya ke inhein pata yaqeen hai aur yeh liye baghair na talenge toh usne apna sar khol kar apne baalon mein se parcha nikaal kar hamein de diya hum ise lekar wapas khidmat-e-Nabawi ﷺ mein hazir hue, Hazrat Umar R.A yeh waqiya sun kar farmaya usne Allah, uske Rasool ﷺ ki aur musalmanon ki khyanat ki mujhe is ki gardan marne ki ijazat dijiye, Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Hatib R.A se دریافت kiya Tumhari qaribatein aur rishtedaariyaan tumhein Allah ke haan kuch kaam na aayengi, agar tum Allah ko naraaz kar ke unhein khush karo aur chaho ke tumhein nafa ho ya nuqsaan hat jaye yeh bilkul khaam-khayali hai, na Allah ki taraf ke nuqsaan ko koi taal sake na us ke diye hue nafa ko koi rok sake, apne walon se un ke kufr par jis ne muwafqat ki woh barbaad hua, go rishtedaar kaisa hi ho kuch nafa nahi, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke aik shakhs ne Rasulullah ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke ya Rasulullah ﷺ mera baap kahan hai? Aap ne farmaya jahannam mein. Jab woh jaane laga to aap ne use bulaya aur farmaya sun mera baap aur tera baap dono hi jahannami hain. Yeh hadith Sahih Muslim Sharif mein aur Sunan Abu Dawood mein bhi hai. Musalmano! Tumhare liye Hazrat Ibrahim ؑ mein aur un ke sathiyon mein behtareen namuna aur achhi pairavi maujood hai. Jabki un sab ne apni qaum se bar-mala keh diya ke hum tum se aur jin jin ki tum Allah ke siva ibadat karte ho un sab se bilkul bezaar hain, hum tumhare aqaid ke munkir hain jab tak tum Allah ki wahdaniyat par iman na laao hum mein tum mein hamesha ke liye adaawat-o-bughz zahir hogaya lekin Ibrahim ki itni baat to apne baap se hui thi ke main tumhare liye istighfar zaroor karunga aur tumhare liye mujhe Allah ke saamne kisi cheez ka ikhtiyar kuch bhi nahi, Aie hamare parvardigar tujh hi par hum ne bharosa kiya hai aur teri hi taraf hum rujoo karte hain aur teri hi taraf lautna hai. Aie Allah tu hamein kafiron ka zabardast aur takhta-e-mashq na bana aur aie hamare paalne wale hamari khataon ko bakhsh de, beshak tu hi ghalib hikmaton wala hai. Yaqinan tumhare liye un mein naik namuna aur umda pairavi hai khaas kar har us shakhs ke liye jo Allah ki aur Qiyamat ke din ki mulaqat ka iteqaad rakhta ho aur agar koi rogardani kare to Allah Ta'ala bilkul be-parwah hai aur woh saza-waar-e-hamd-o-sana hai.

Asabiyat-e-Deen-o-Iman ka juz-e-layanfak hai Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko kuffar se muwalat aur dosti na karne ki hidayat farma kar unke samne apne Khalil aur unke ashab ka namoona pesh kar raha hai ke unhone saf taur par apne rishta-e-kunbe aur kaum ke logon se baramala farma diya ke hum tum se aur jinhe tum pujte ho un se bezar, bari-uz-zimma aur alag-thalag hain, hum tumhare deen aur tareeqe se mutanaffir hain, jab tak tum usi tareeqe aur usi mazhab par ho tum humein apna dushman samjho. Na mumkin hai ke biradri ki wajah se hum tumhare is kufr ke bawajood tum se bhai-chara aur dostana talluqat rakhein, han yeh aur baat hai ke Allah tumhein hidayat de aur tum Allah wahdahu la sharika lahu par iman le aao, uski tauheed ko maan lo aur usi ki ibadat shuru kar do aur jin jin ko tum ne Allah ka shareek aur sajhi thahra rakha hai aur jin jin ki pooja-paat mein mashghool ho un sab ko tark kar do, apni is rosh-e-kufr aur tareeq-e-shirk se hat jao tum phir beshak hamare bhai ho, hamare azeez ho, warna hum mein tum mein koi ittehad-o-ittifaq nahi, hum tum se aur tum hum se alehda ho. Han yeh yaad rahe ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ne apne walid se jo istighfar ka wada kiya tha aur phir use pura kiya us mein unki iqtida nahi, is liye ke yeh istighfar us waqt tak raha jis waqt tak ke apne walid ka dushman-e-Khuda hona un par wazahat ke sath zahir na hua tha, jab unhe yaqeeni taur par uski Allah se dushmani khul gayi toh us se saf bezari zahir kar di. Baz momin apne mushrik maa-baap ke liye dua-o-istighfar karte thay aur sanad mein Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ka apne walid ke liye dua mangna pesh karte thay, is par Allah Ta'ala ne apna farman (tarjuma) poori do aayton tak nazil farmaya aur yahan bhi uswa-e-Ibrahimi mein se is ka istisna kar liya ke is baat mein unki pairwi tumhare liye mamnu hai aur Hazrat Ibrahim ke is istighfar ki tafseel bhi kar di aur is ka khas sabab aur khas waqt bhi bayan farma diya. Hazrat Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Qatada, Muqatil bin Hayyan, Dahhak waghera ne bhi yahi matlab bayan kiya hai. 

Phir irshad hota hai ke kaum se bara'at kar ke ab Allah ki bargah mein aate hain aur Janab-e-Bari mein aajizi aur inkisari se arz karte hain ke Bari Ta'ala tamam kamon mein hamara bharosa aur aetmad teri hi pak zat par hai, hum apne tamam kaam tujhe saunptte hain, teri taraf rujoo-o-raghbat karte hain, dar-e-akhirat mein bhi humein teri hi janib lautna hai. Phir kehte hain Ilahi tu hamein kuffar ke liye fitna na bana, yaani aisa na ho ke yeh hum par ghalib aa kar humein museebat mein mubtala kar dein, isi tarah yeh bhi na ho ke teri taraf se hum par koi aitab-o-azab nazil ho aur woh unke aur behakne ka sabab bane ke agar yeh haq par hote toh Allah inhein azab kyun karta?

Agar yeh kisi maidan mein jeet gaye toh bhi in ke liye yeh fitna ka sabab hoga woh samjheinge ke hamein is liye ghalib aaye ke hum hi haq par hain, isi tarah agar yeh hum par ghalib aa gaye toh aisa na ho ke hamein takleefein pohancha pohancha kar tere deen se bargashta kardein. Phir dua mangte hain ke Ilahi hamare gunahon ko bhi bakhsh de, hamari parda-poshi kar aur hamein maaf farma, Tu Aziz hai teri janab mein panah dene wala namurad nahi phirta tere dar par dastak dene wala khali hath nahi jata, Tu apni shariat ke taqarrur mein apne aqwal-o-afaal mein aur qaza-o-qadar ke muqaddar karne mein hikmaton wala hai, tera koi kaam hikmat se khali nahi. Phir ba-toor-e-taakeed ke wohi pehli baat dohrai jati hai ke in mein tumhare liye naik namoona hai jo bhi Allah Ta'ala par aur qayamat ke aane ki haqeeqat par iman rakhta ho use in ki iqtida mein aage barh kar qadam rakhna chahiye aur jo ahkaam Allah se rogardani kare woh jaan le ke Allah us se be-parwah hai woh layak hamd-o-sana hai makhlooq us khaliq ki tareef mein mashghool hai, jaise aur jagah hai (tarjuma) "Agar tum aur tamam ro-e-zameen ke log kufr par aur Allah ke na manne par utr aayein toh Allah Ta'ala ka kuch nahi bigaar sakte Allah Ta'ala sab se ghani sab se be-niyaz aur sab se be-parwah hai aur woh tareef kiya gaya hai" Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ghani use kaha jata hai jo apne ghina mein kamil ho. Allah Ta'ala hi ki yeh sifat hai ke woh har tarah se be-niyaz aur bilkul be-parwah hai kisi aur ki zat aisi nahi, uska koi hamsar nahi uske misl koi aur nahi woh pak hai akela hai sab par hakim sab par ghalib sab ka badshah hai, Hameed hai yaani makhlooq use sarah rahi hai, apne jamee aqwal mein tamam afaal mein woh sitaisho aur tareefon wala hai uske siva koi mabood nahi uske siva koi palne wala nahi, Rab wahi hai mabood wahi hai.

Kuffar se mohabbat ki mamanat ki dobara takeed. Kafiroun se mohabbat rakhne ki mamanat aur un ke bughz-o-adawat ke bayan ke baad ab irshad hota hai ki basa auqaat mumkin hai ki abhi abhi Allah tum mein aur un mein mel milap kara de, bughz, nafrat aur furqat ke baad mohabbat, mawaddat aur ulfat paida kar de, kaunsi cheez hai jis par Allah qadir na ho? Woh mubayyan aur mukhtarif cheezon ko jama kar sakta hai, adawat-o-qasawat ke baad dilon mein ulfat-o-mohabbat paida kar dena us ke hath mein hai, jaise aur jagah Ansar par apni na'mat bayan karte hue irshad huwa hai (tarjumah) al-kh tum par jo Allah ki na'mat hai use yaad karo ki tumhari dili adawat ko us ne ulfat-o-qalbi se badal diya aur tum aise ho gaye jaise maan jaye bhai hon tum aag ke kinare pahunch chuke the lekin us ne tumhein wahan se bacha liya, An-Hazrat ﷺ ne ansariyon se farmaya kya main ne tumhein gumrahi ki halat mein nahi paya tha? Phir Allah Ta'ala ne meri wajah se tumhein hidayat di aur tum mutafarriq the meri wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne tumhein jama kar diya, Quran-e-Kareem mein hai (tarjumah) al-kh Allah Ta'ala ne apni madad se mominon ko sath kar ke, Ayy Nabi! Teri madad ki aur iman-daron mein aapas mein woh mohabbat aur yakjehti paida kar di ki agar ro-e-zameen ki daulat kharch karte aur yagana-gat paida karna chahte toh woh na kar sakte yeh ulfat min-janib-Allah thi jo Azeez-o-Hakeem hai. Ek hadis mein hai: doston ki dosti ke waqt bhi is baat ko pesh-e-nazar rakho ki kya ajab is se kisi waqt dushmani ho jaye aur dushmanon ki dushmani mein bhi had se tajawuz na karo kya khabar kab dosti ho jaye, arab shaayar kahta hai.

Yaani aise do dushmanon mein bhi jo ek se ek juda hon aur is tarah ke dil mein girah de li ho ke abad-ul-abad tak ab kabhi na milenge Allah Ta'ala ittefaq-o-ittehad paida kar deta hai aur is tarah ek ho jaate hain ke goya kabhi do na the, Allah Ta'ala Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai, kafir jab tauba karein toh Allah qubool farma lega jab woh us ki taraf jhukein woh unhein apne saaye mein le lega, koi sa gunah ho aur koi sa gunehgar ho udhar woh Malik ki taraf jhuka udhar us ki rahmat ki aagosh khuli, Hazrat Muqatil bin Hayan R.H farmate hain yeh aayat Abu Sufyan Sakhar bin Harb ke baare mein nazil hui hai un ki sahibzadi sahiba se Rasulullah ﷺ ne nikah kar liya tha aur yahi munakahat hujjat ka sabab ban gayi, lekin yeh قول kuch jee ko nahi lagta is liye ke Rasulullah ﷺ ka yeh nikah Fath-e-Makkah se bahut pehle hua tha aur Hazrat Abu Sufyan ka Islam bil-ittifaq Fath-e-Makkah ki raat ka hai, balke is se bahut achhi taujeeh toh woh hai jo Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Sufyan Sakhar bin Harb ko kisi baagh ke phalon ka aamil bana rakha tha Huzoor ﷺ ke inteqal ke baad yeh aa rahe the ke raste mein Zul-Humar murtad mil gaya aap ne us se jang ki aur baqaida lade, pas murtadeen se pehle pehal ladai ladne wale Mujahid-fi-Dein aap hain, Hazrat Ibn Shihab ka qaul hai ke unhi ke baare mein yeh aayat 'Asal-Allahu alai-kum' utri hai, Sahih Muslim Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Sufyan ne Islam qubool karne ke baad Huzoor ﷺ se kaha ke Ya Rasulullah ﷺ meri teen darkhwastein hain agar ijazat ho toh arz karoon, aap ne farmaya kaho, us ne kaha awal toh yeh ke mujhe ijazat dijiye ke jis tarah main kufr ke zamane mein musalmanon se musalsal jang karta raha ab Islam ke zamane mein kafiron se barabar ladai jaari rakhun, aap ne ise manzoor farmaya, phir kaha mere ladke Muawiya ko apna munshi bana lijiye, aap ne ise bhi manzoor farma liya (is par jo kalam hai woh pehle guzar chuka hai) aur meri behtareen Arab bachi Umme Habiba ko aap apni zaujiyat mein qubool farmayen, aap ne yeh bhi manzoor farma liya (is par bhi kalam pehle guzar chuka hai), phir irshad hota hai ke jin kuffar ne tum se mazhabi ladai nahi ki na tumhe jala-watan Farmaya is tarah ke Allah ki qasam kha kar sach sach kahe ke woh apne khawand ki nachaqi ki wajah se nahi chali aayin sirf aab-o-hawa aur zameen ki tabdeeli karne ke liye ba-taur sair-o-siyahat nahi hui kisi duniya talbi ke liye nahi aayin balki sirf Allah ki aur Us ke Rasool ﷺ ki mohabbat ki khatir Islam ki khatir tark-e-watan kiya hai aur koi gharz nahi, qasam de kar un sawalat ka karna aur khoob aazma lena yeh kaam Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ke supurd tha aur riwayat mein hai ke imtihan is tarah hota tha ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke mabood-e-barhaq aur la-shareek hone ki gawahi dein aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ke Allah ke bande aur Us ke bheje hue Rasool hone ki shahadat dein, agar aazmaish mein kisi gharz-e-dunyavi ka pata chal jata toh unhein wapas lotane ka hukm tha. Masalan yeh maloom ho jaye ke miyan biwi ki an-ban ki wajah se ya kisi aur shakhs ki mohabbat mein chali aayin hain waghera, is ayat ke is jumla se ke agar tumhein maloom ho jaye ke yeh ba-iman aurat hai toh phir usey kafiron ki taraf mat lotao sabit hota hai ke iman par bhi yaqeeni taur par muttali ho jana mumkin amr hai.

Hazrat Zainab ne apni walda Hazrat Khadija R.A ka haar un ke fidiye mein bheja tha ke yeh azad ho kar ayen jise dekh kar An-Hazrat ﷺ par badi riqqat tari hui aur Aap ﷺ ne musalmanon se farmaya agar meri beti ke qaidi ko chhod dena tum pasand karte ho to isse raha kardo, musalmanon ne ba-khushi baghair fidiya ke unhein chhod dena منظور kiya, chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne unhein azad kardiya aur farma diya ke aap ki sahibzadi ko aap ke pas Madina mein bhej dein, unhon ne isse منظور karliya aur Hazrat Zaid bin Haritha R.A ke sath bhej bhi diya. Yeh waqia san 2 hijri ka hai, Hazrat Zainab ne Madina mein hi iqamat farmayi aur yuhin baithi rahein yahan tak ke san 8 hijri mein un ke khawand Hazrat Abul Aas ko Allah Ta'ala ne taufeeq-e-Islam di aur woh musalman hogaye to Huzoor ﷺ ne phir usi agle nikah baghair naye mhar ke apni sahibzadi ko un ke pas rukhsat kardiya aur riwayat mein hai ke do saal ke baad Hazrat Abul Aas musalman hogaye the aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne usi pehle nikah par Hazrat Zainab ko lotadiya tha, yahi sahi hai is liye ke musalman aurton ke mushrik mardo par haram hone ke do saal baad yeh musalman hogaye the. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke Islam ke baad naye sire se nikah hua aur naya mhar bandha, Imam Tirmidhi Rahimahullah farmate hain ke Hazrat Yazid ne farmaya hai pehli riwayat ke rawi Hazrat Ibn Abbas hain aur woh riwayat az-roo-e-asnad ke bahut aala aur dusri riwayat ke rawi Hazrat Amr bin Shu'aib hain aur amal isi par hai, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Amr bin Shu'aib wali riwayat ke ek rawi Hajjaj bin Artah ko Hazrat Imam Ahmad Rahimahullah waghera zaeef batate hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas wali hadith ka jawab jamhuriya dete hain ke yeh shakhsi waqia hai mumkin hai un ki iddat khatam hi na hui ho, aksar hazraat ka mazhab yeh hai ke is surat mein jab aurat ne iddat ke din poore kar liye aur ab tak uska kafir khawand musalman nahin hua to woh nikah faskh hojata hai, haan ba'z hazraat ka mazhab yeh bhi hai ke iddat poori kar lene ke baad aurat ko ikhtiyar hai agar chahe apne is nikah ko baqi rakhe ga chahe faskh kar ke dusra nikah karle aur isi par Ibn Abbas wali riwayat ko mahmool karte hain. Phir hukam hota hai ke in muhajir aurton ke kafir khawandon ko un ke kharch ikhrajat jo hue hain woh ada kardo jaise ke mhar.

Phir farmaan hai ke ab unhein un ke mahr de kar un se nikah kar lene mein tum par koi haraj nahin, iddat ka guzar jana wali ka muqarrar karna waghera jo umoor nikah mein zaroori hain un sharaait ko poora kar ke un muhajira aurton se jo musalman nikah karna chahe kar sakta hai. Phir irshad hota hai ke tum par bhi aye musalmano un aurton ka apne nikah mein baqi rakhna haram hai jo kafira hain, isi tarah kafir aurton se nikah karna bhi haram hai is ke hukm nazil hote hi Hazrat Umar R.A ne apni do kafir biwiyon ko foran talaq de di jin mein se ek ne to Muawiyah bin Sufyan se nikah kar liya aur doosri ne Safwan bin Umayyah ne, Huzoor ﷺ ne kafiron se sulah ki aur abhi to Aap Hudaibiyah ke neeche ke hisse mein hi thay ke yeh ayat nazil hui aur musalmano se keh diya gaya ke jo aurat muhajira aaye us ka ba-eeman hona aur khuloos-e-niyyat se hijrat karna bhi maloom ho jaye toh us ke kafir khawindon ko un ke diye huwe mahr wapas kar do, isi tarah kafiron ko bhi yeh hukm suna diya gaya, is hukm ki wajah woh ahd-nama tha jo abhi abhi murattab huwa tha. Hazrat Al-Farooq ne apni jin do kafira biwiyon ko talaq di un mein se pehli ka naam Quraibah tha yeh Abu Umayyah bin Mughirah ki larki thi aur doosri ka naam Umm-e-Kulsoom tha jo Amr bin Harool Khuzaee ki larki thi, Hazrat Ubaidullah ki walida yeh hi thi, is se Abu Jaham bin Huzaifah bin Ghanam Khuzaee ne nikah kar liya yeh bhi mushrik tha, isi tarah is hukm ke matahat Hazrat Talha bin Ubaidullah ne apni kafira biwi Arwa bint Rabeea bin Haris bin Abdul Muttalib ko talaq de di, is se Khalid bin Saeed bin Aas ne nikah kar liya. Phir irshad hota hai tumhari biwiyon par jo tum ne kharch kiya hai use kafiron se le lo jabke woh un mein chali jayen aur kafiron ki auratein jo musalman ho kar tum mein aa jayen unhein tum un ka kiya huwa kharch de do. Sulah ke bare mein aur aurton ke bare mein Allah ka faisla bayan ho chuka jo us ne apni makhlooq mein kar diya, Allah Ta'ala apne bando ki tamam tar maslihaton se ba-khabar hai aur us ka koi hukm hikmat se khali nahin hota is liye ke ala-itlaq Hakeem wahi hai. Is ke baad ki ayat "Wa in fatakum..." ka matlab Hazrat Qatadah R.H yeh bayan farmate hain ke jin kuffar se tumhara ahd-o-paiman sulah-o-safai nahin, agar koi عورت kisi musalman ke ghar se ja kar un mein ja mile toh zahir hai ke woh us ke khawand ka kiya huwa kharch nahin denge toh us ke badle tumhein bhi ijazat di jati hai ke agar un mein se koi aurat musalman ho kar tum mein chali aaye toh tum bhi us ke khawand ko kuch na do jab tak woh na dein.

Hazrat Zuhri (Rahimahullah) farmate hain musalmanon ne to Allah ke is hukm ki taamil ki aur kafiron ki jo auratein musalman ho kar hijrat kar ke aaein un ke liye hue mohr un ke khawandon ko wapas kiye lekin mushrikon ne is hukm ke manne se inkar kar diya is par yeh ayat utri aur musalmanon ko ijazat di gayi ke agar tum mein se koi aurat un ke han chali gayi hai aur unhon ne tumhari kharch ki hui raqam ada nahi ki to jab un mein se koi aurat tumhare han aa jaye to tum apna woh kharch nikal kar baqi agar kuch bache to de do warna mamla khatam hua, Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) se is ka yeh matlab marwi hai ke is mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko yeh hukm diya jata hai ke jo musalman aurat kafiron mein ja mile aur kafir us ke khawand ko us ka kiya hua kharch ada na karein to maal-e-ghanimat mein se Aap us musalman ko biqadr us ke kharch ke de dein, pas fa-uqubtum ke ma’ne yeh hue ke phir tumhain Quraysh ya kisi aur jamat-e-kufaar se maal-e-ghanimat hath lage to un mardon ko jin ki auratein kafiron mein chali gayi hain un ka kiya hua kharch ada kar do, yani mohr-e-misl, un aqwal mein koi tazad nahi matlab yeh hai ke pehli surat agar namumkin ho to woh sahi warna maal-e-ghanimat mein se use us ka haq de diya jaye dono baton mein ikhtiyar hai aur hukm mein wusat hai Hazrat Imam Ibn Jareer is tatbeeq ko pasand farmate hain, f Alhamdulillah.

Sulh-e-Hudaibiyah ka aik pehlu: Surah Al-Fath ki tafseer mein Sulh-e-Hudaibiyah ka waqia mufassal bayan ho chuka hai, is sulh ke mauqe par Rasool Allah ﷺ aur Kuffar-e-Quresh ke darmiyan jo sharait hui thin un mein aik yeh bhi thi ke jo kafir مسلمان ho kar Huzoor ﷺ ke paas chala jaye aap usey Ahl-e-Makkah ko wapas kar dein, lekin Quran-e-Kareem ne un mein se un aurton ko مخصوص kar diya ke jo aurat iman qubool kar ke aaye aur fi-waqi' ho bhi woh sachi iman daar toh مسلمان usey kafiron ko wapas na dein, Hadees-e-Sharief ki takhsees Quran-e-Kareem se hone ki yeh aik behtareen misaal hai aur ba'z Salaf ke nazdeek yeh ayat is hadees ki nasikh hai. Is ayat ka shaan-e-nuzool yeh hai ke Hazrat Umm-e-Kulsoom bint Uqbah bin Abu Mui't R.A مسلمان ho kar hijrat kar ke Madina chali aayin, un ke dono bhai Ammarah aur Waleed un ke wapas lene ke liye Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hue aur aap se kaha suna pas yeh ayat-e-imtihan nazil hui aur momina aurton ko wapas lotane se mamanat kar di gayi, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se sawal hota hai ke Huzoor ﷺ un aurton ka imtihan kis tarah lete thay? Farmaya is tarah ke Allah ki qasam kha kar sach sach kahe ke woh apne khawand ki nachaqi ki wajah se nahi chali aayin sirf aab-o-hawa aur zameen ki tabdeeli karne ke liye ba-taur sair-o-siyahat nahi hui kisi duniya talbi ke liye nahi aayin balki sirf Allah ki aur Us ke Rasool ﷺ ki mohabbat ki khatir Islam ki khatir tark-e-watan kiya hai aur koi gharz nahi, qasam de kar un sawalat ka karna aur khoob aazma lena yeh kaam Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ke supurd tha aur riwayat mein hai ke imtihan is tarah hota tha ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke mabood-e-barhaq aur la-shareek hone ki gawahi dein aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ke Allah ke bande aur Us ke bheje hue Rasool hone ki shahadat dein, agar aazmaish mein kisi gharz-e-dunyavi ka pata chal jata toh unhein wapas lotane ka hukm tha. Masalan yeh maloom ho jaye ke miyan biwi ki an-ban ki wajah se ya kisi aur shakhs ki mohabbat mein chali aayin hain waghera, is ayat ke is jumla se ke agar tumhein maloom ho jaye ke yeh ba-iman aurat hai toh phir usey kafiron ki taraf mat lotao sabit hota hai ke iman par bhi yaqeeni taur par muttali ho jana mumkin amr hai.

Phir irshad hota hai ke musalman aurtein kafiron par aur kafir mard musalman aurton ke liye halal nahin, is ayat ne is rishte ko haram kardiya warna is se pehle momina aurton ka nikah kafir mardoos se jaiz tha, jaise ke Nabi ﷺ ki sahibzadi Hazrat Zainab R.A ka nikah Abul Aas bin Rabih se hua tha halanki yeh us waqt kafir the aur bint-e-Rasool ﷺ muslima theen, Badr ki ladaayi mein yeh bhi kafiron ke sath the aur jo kafir zinda pakde gaye the un mein yeh bhi giraftar ho kar aaye the. Hazrat Zainab ne apni walda Hazrat Khadija R.A ka haar un ke fidiye mein bheja tha ke yeh azad ho kar ayen jise dekh kar An-Hazrat ﷺ par badi riqqat tari hui aur Aap ﷺ ne musalmanon se farmaya agar meri beti ke qaidi ko chhod dena tum pasand karte ho to isse raha kardo, musalmanon ne ba-khushi baghair fidiya ke unhein chhod dena منظور kiya, chunacha Huzoor ﷺ ne unhein azad kardiya aur farma diya ke aap ki sahibzadi ko aap ke pas Madina mein bhej dein, unhon ne isse منظور karliya aur Hazrat Zaid bin Haritha R.A ke sath bhej bhi diya. Yeh waqia san 2 hijri ka hai, Hazrat Zainab ne Madina mein hi iqamat farmayi aur yuhin baithi rahein yahan tak ke san 8 hijri mein un ke khawand Hazrat Abul Aas ko Allah Ta'ala ne taufeeq-e-Islam di aur woh musalman hogaye to Huzoor ﷺ ne phir usi agle nikah baghair naye mhar ke apni sahibzadi ko un ke pas rukhsat kardiya aur riwayat mein hai ke do saal ke baad Hazrat Abul Aas musalman hogaye the aur An-Hazrat ﷺ ne usi pehle nikah par Hazrat Zainab ko lotadiya tha, yahi sahi hai is liye ke musalman aurton ke mushrik mardo par haram hone ke do saal baad yeh musalman hogaye the. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke un ke Islam ke baad naye sire se nikah hua aur naya mhar bandha, Imam Tirmidhi Rahimahullah farmate hain ke Hazrat Yazid ne farmaya hai pehli riwayat ke rawi Hazrat Ibn Abbas hain aur woh riwayat az-roo-e-asnad ke bahut aala aur dusri riwayat ke rawi Hazrat Amr bin Shu'aib hain aur amal isi par hai, lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Amr bin Shu'aib wali riwayat ke ek rawi Hajjaj bin Artah ko Hazrat Imam Ahmad Rahimahullah waghera zaeef batate hain. Hazrat Ibn Abbas wali hadith ka jawab jamhuriya dete hain ke yeh shakhsi waqia hai mumkin hai un ki iddat khatam hi na hui ho, aksar hazraat ka mazhab yeh hai ke is surat mein jab aurat ne iddat ke din poore kar liye aur ab tak uska kafir khawand musalman nahin hua to woh nikah faskh hojata hai, haan ba'z hazraat ka mazhab yeh bhi hai ke iddat poori kar lene ke baad aurat ko ikhtiyar hai agar chahe apne is nikah ko baqi rakhe ga chahe faskh kar ke dusra nikah karle aur isi par Ibn Abbas wali riwayat ko mahmool karte hain. Khawateen ka tareeqa-e-bai'at: Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai, Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ne farmaya hai ke jo musalman auratein Aan-e-Hazrat ﷺ ke paas hijrat kar ke aati theen, un ka imtihan usi ayat se hota tha. Jo aurat un tamam baaton ka ikrar kar leti, use Huzoor ﷺ zabani farma dete ke main ne tum se bai'at ki. Yeh nahi ke Aap un ke haath se haath milate hon. Allah ki qasam! Aap ne kabhi bai'at karte hue kisi aurat ke haath ko haath nahi lagaya, sirf zabani farma dete ke in baaton par main ne teri bai'at li. 

Tirmizi, Nasai, Ibn Majah, Musnad Ahmad waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Umaimah bint Ruqeeqah farmati hain, kai ek auraton ke sath main bhi Aan-e-Hazrat ﷺ se bai'at karne ke liye hazir hui, to Quran ki is ayat ke mutabiq Aap ne hum se ahd-o-paimaan liya aur hum bhali baaton mein Huzoor ﷺ ki na-farmani na karein gi ke ikrar ke waqt farmaya: Yeh bhi keh lo ke jahan tak tumhari taaqat hai. Hum ne kaha: Allah ko aur Us ke Rasul ﷺ ko hamara khayal hum se bahut ziyada hai aur un ki meharbani bhi hum par khud hamari meharbani se barh charh kar hai. Phir hum ne kaha: Huzoor ﷺ! Aap hum se musafaha nahi karte? Farmaya: Nahi, main ghair auraton se musafaha nahi kiya karta, mera ek aurat se keh dena sau auraton ki bai'at ke liye kafi hai, bas bai'at ho chuki. Imam Tirmizi is hadith ko Hasan Sahih kehte hain. 

Musnad Ahmad mein itni ziyadati aur bhi hai ke hum mein se kisi aurat ke sath Huzoor ﷺ ne musafaha nahi kiya. Yeh Hazrat Umaimah, Hazrat Khadija ki behan aur Hazrat Fatima ki khala hoti hain. 

Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Salma bint Qais (R.A) jo Rasulullah ﷺ ki khala theen aur dono qiblon ki taraf Huzoor ﷺ ke sath namaz ada ki thi, jo Banu Adi bin Najjar ke qabeela mein se theen, farmati hain: Ansar ki auraton ke sath khidmat-e-nabwi mein bai'at karne ke liye main bhi aayi thi aur is ayat mein jin baaton ka zikr hai, un ka hum ne ikrar kiya. Aap ne farmaya: Is baat ka bhi ikrar karo ke apne khawand-o-khawandon ki khyanat aur un ke sath dhokha na karogi. Hum ne is ka bhi ikrar kiya, bai'at ki aur jaane lageen. Phir mujhe khayal aaya aur ek aurat ko main ne Huzoor ﷺ ke paas bheja ke woh daryaft kar lein ke khyanat-o-dhokha na karne se Aap ka kya matlab hai? Aap ne farmaya: Yeh ke is ka maal chupke se kisi aur ko na do.

Musnad ki hadith mein hai Hazrat Aishah bint Qudamah farmati hain, "Main apni walidah Rabitah bint Sufiyan naziah ke sath Huzoor ﷺ se bay'at karne waliyon mein thi. Huzoor ﷺ in baaton par bay'at le rahe thay aur aurtein un ka iqrar karti thin. Meri walidah ke farman se main ne bhi iqrar kiya aur bay'at waliyon mein shamil hui." 

Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Umm Atiyah se naqal hai ke hum ne in baaton par aur is amr par ke hum kisi maray par nauha na karein gi, Huzoor ﷺ se bay'at ki. Isi asna mein ek aurat ne apna hath samait liya aur kaha, "Main nauha karne se baaz rehne par bay'at nahi karti, is liye ke falan aurat ne mere falan maray par nauha karne mein meri madad ki hai, to main is ka badla zaroor utarungi." An-Hazrat ﷺ ise sun kar khamosh rahe aur kuch na farmaya. Woh chali gayin lekin phir thodi hi der mein wapas aayin aur bay'at kar li. 

Muslim Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai aur itni ziyadati bhi hai ke is shart ko sirf us aurat ne aur Hazrat Umm Sulaim bint Milhan ne hi pura kiya. Bukhari ki aur riwayat mein hai ke paanch aurتون ne is ahad ko pura kiya: Umm Sulaim, Umm Allam, Abu Sabrah ki beti jo Hazrat Mu'az ki biwi thin, aur do aur aurtein (ya Abu Sabrah ki beti aur Hazrat Mu'az ki biwi aur ek aurat aur). 

Nabi ﷺ eid wale din bhi aurton se is bay'at ka muahida liya karte thay. Bukhari mein hai Hazrat Ibn Abbas farmate hain ke Ramazan ki eid ki namaz main ne An-Hazrat ﷺ ke sath aur Abu Bakr, Umar, Usman (R.A) ke sath padhi hai. Sab ke sab khutbe se pehle namaz padhte thay, phir namaz ke baad khutba kehte thay. Ek martaba Nabi ﷺ khutbe se utre (goya woh naqsha meri nigaah ke samne hai) ke logon ko bithaya jata tha aur aap un ke darmiyan se tashrif la rahe thay yahan tak ke aurton ke paas aaye, aap ke sath Hazrat Bilal thay. Yahan pahunch kar aap ne isi ayat ki tilawat ki, phir aap ne daryaft kiya ke kya tum apne is iqrar par sabit-qadam ho? Ek aurat ne khade ho kar jawab diya ke haan, Huzoor ﷺ is par mazbooti ke sath qaim hain. Kisi aur ne jawab nahi diya, rawi-e-hadith Hazrat Hasan ko yeh maloom nahi ke yeh jawab dene wali kaunsi aurat thin. Phir aap ne farmaya, "Achha khairat karo." Aur Hazrat Bilal ne apna kapra phaila diya, chunacha aurton ne is par be-nagina ki aur nagina-dar anguthyan rah-e-Khuda daal din. 

Musnad Ahmad ki riwayat mein Hazrat Umaimah ki bay'at ke zikr ke ilawa ayat ke alawa itna aur bhi hai ke nauha karna aur jahiliyat ke zamane ki tarah apna banao-singhar ghair mardon ko na dikhana. 

Bukhari Muslim ki hadith mein hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne mardon se bhi ek majlis mein farmaya ke mujh se in baaton par bay'at karo jo is ayat mein hain, jo shakhs is bay'at ko nibha de us ka ajr Allah ke zimmah hai aur jo is ke khilaf kar guzre aur woh Muslim hukumat se poshida rahe, us ka hisab Allah ke paas hai, agar chahe bakhsh de aur agar chahe azab kare. 

Hazrat Ubadah bin Samit (R.A) farmate hain ke Aqbah-e-Ula mein hum barah shakhson ne Rasulullah ﷺ se bay'at ki aur unhi baaton par jo is ayat mein mazkoor hain, aap ne hum se bay'at li aur farmaya, "Agar tum is par poore utre to yaqinan tumhare liye jannat hai." Yeh waqia jihad ki farziyat se pehle ka hai. 

Ibn Jarir ki riwayat mein hai ke Rasulullah ﷺ ne Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko hukum diya ke woh aurton se kahein ke Rasulullah ﷺ tum se is baat par bay'at lete hain ke tum Allah Ta'ala ke sath kisi ko sharik na karo. In bay'at ke liye aane waliyon mein Hazrat Hindah thin jo Utbah bin Rabiah ki beti aur Hazrat Sufiyan ki biwi thin. Yahi thin jinhon ne apne kufr ke zamane mein Huzoor ﷺ ke chacha Hazrat Hamzah (R.A) ka pait cheer diya tha, is wajah se yeh in aurton mein aisi halat se aayin thin ke koi inhein pechan na sake. Is ne jab farman suna to kehne lagi, "Main kuch kehna chahti hoon lekin agar bolungi to Huzoor ﷺ mujhe pechan lenge aur agar pechan lenge to mere qatal ka hukum de denge, main isi wajah se is tarah aayi hoon ke na pechani jaun." Magar aur aurtein sab khamosh rahein aur un ki baat apni zuban se kehne se inkar kar diya. Aakhir un hi ko kehna pada ke yeh theek hai, jab shirk ki mamanat mardon ko hai to aurton ko kyun na hogi?

Huzoor ﷺ ne un ki taraf dekha lekin Aap ne kuch na farmaya phir Hazrat Umar se kaha un se keh do ke dusri baat yeh hai ke yeh chori na karein, is par Hinda ne kaha main Abu Sufyan ki mamooli si cheez kabhi kabhi le liya karti hoon kya yeh bhi chori mein dakhil hai ya nahi? Aur mere liye yeh halal bhi hai ya nahi? Hazrat Abu Sufyan bhi usi majlis mein mojood thay, yeh sunte hi kehne lage mere ghar mein jo kuch bhi tu ne liya ho khwah woh kharch mein aa gaya ho ya ab bhi baaqi ho woh sab main tere liye halal karta hoon, ab to Nabi ﷺ ne saaf pehchan liya ke yeh mere chacha Hamza ki qatila aur is ke kaleje ko cheerne wali phir ise chabane wali aurat Hinda hai, Aap ne unhein pehchan kar aur un ki yeh guftgoo dekh kar muskra diye aur unhein apne bulaya unhein aa kar Huzoor ﷺ ka haath thaam kar muafi mangi Aap ne farmaya. Tum wohi Hinda ho? Unhone kaha guzishta gunah Allah Ta'ala ne maaf farma diye Huzoor ﷺ khamosh ho rahe hain aur bai'at ke silsile mein phir lag gaye aur farmaya teesri baat yeh hai ke in aurton mein se koi badkaari na kare, is par Hazrat Hinda ne kaha kya koi aazad aurat bhi badkaari karti hai? Aap ne farmaya theek hai Allah ki qasam aazad auratein is bure kaam se hargiz alooda nahi hoteen, Aap ne phir farmaya jo chauthi baat yeh hai ke apni aulad ko qatal na karein, Hinda ne kaha Aap ne unhein Badr ke din qatal kiya hai Aap jaanein aur woh, Aap ne farmaya paanchween baat yeh hai ke khud apni hi taraf se jodh kar be-sar-pair ka koi khaas buhtan na tarash lein aur chhati baat yeh hai ke meri sharai baaton mein meri na-farmani na karein aur saatwan ahad Aap ne un se yeh bhi liya ke woh nauha na karein, ahl-e-jahiliyat apne kisi ke mar jaane par kapde phaad daalte thay munh noch lete thay baal katwa dete thay aur haaye waaye kya karte thay. Yeh asar ghareeb hai aur is ke baaz hisse mein nakarat bhi hai is liye ke Abu Sufyan aur un ki biwi Hinda ke islam ke waqt unhein Huzoor ﷺ ki taraf se koi andesha na tha balki is se bhi Aap ne safai aur muhabbat ka izhar kar diya tha, Wallahu A'lam, aik aur riwayat mein hai ke Fath-e-Makkah wale din bai'at wali yeh aayat nazil hui Nabi ﷺ ne Safa par mardon se bai'at li aur Hazrat Umar ne aurton se bai'at li is mein itna aur bhi hai ke aulad ke qatal ki mumanat sun kar Hazrat Hinda (R.A) ne farmaya ke hum ne to unhein chhootpan mein paal pos kar bada kiya lekin in badoon ko tum ne qatal kiya, is par Hazrat Umar maare hansi ke loot loot gaye, Ibn Abi Hatim ki riwayat mein hai ke jab Hinda bai'at karne aayein to un ke haath mardon ki tarah safed thay Aap ne farmaya jao un ka rang badal lo, chunacha woh mehndi laga kar hazir huin, un ke haath mein do sone ke kade thay unhone poocha ke in ki nisbat kya hukm hai?

Farmaya Jahannam ki aag ke do angarey hain, (yeh hukm us waqt hai jab un ki zakat na ada ki jaye) is bai'at ke lene ke waqt Aap ke haath mein ek kapra tha, jab aulaadon ke qatal ki mamanat par un se ahad liya gaya to ek aurat ne kaha un ke baap dadaon ko to qatal kiya aur un ki aulaad ki wasiyat hamein ho rahi hai, yeh shuru shuru mein surat bai'at ki thi lekin phir is ke baad Aap ne yeh dastoor kar rakha tha ki jab bai'at karne ke liye auratein jama hojatrin to Aap yeh sab baatein un par pesh farmate woh un ka iqraar kartin aur wapas laut jatin, pas farman-e-Ilahi hai ke jo aurat in umoor par bai'at karne ke liye aaye to us se bai'at le lo ke Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na karna, ghair logon ke maal na churana, haan us aurat ko jis ka khawand apni taqat ke mutabiq khane peene pehne orhne ko na deta ho jaiz hai ke apne khawand ke maal se mutabiq-e-dastoor aur baqadar apni haajat ke le go khawand ko is ka ilm na ho is ki daleel Hazrat Hindah wali hadith hai ke unhon ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ mere khawand Abu Sufiyan bakheel aadmi hain woh mujhe itna kharch nahi dete jo mujhe aur meri aulaadon ko kafi ho sake to kya main agar un ki be-khabari mein aur un ke maal se le loon to mujhe jaiz hai? Aap ne farmaya ba-tareeq-e-ma'roof is ke maal se itna le le jo tujhe aur tere baal bachon ko kifayat kare (Bukhari o Muslim) aur zina-kari na karein, jaise aur jagah hai Wala taqrabuz zina innahu kana fahishatan wa sa'a sabeela zina ke qareeb na jao woh be-hayai hai aur buri rah hai, Hazrat Samurah wali hadith mein zina ki saza aur dard-naak azaab Jahannam bayan kiya gaya hai, Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Fatimah bint Utbah jab bai'at ke liye aayen aur is ayat ki tilawat un ke samne ki gayi to unhon ne sharm se apna haath apne sar par rakh liya Aap ko un ki yeh haya achhi maloom hui. Hazrat Aisha ne farmaya inhi sharton par hum sab ne bai'at ki hai yeh sun kar unhon ne bhi bai'at karli, Huzoor ﷺ ki bai'at ke tareeqe upar bayan ho chuke hain, aulaad ko qatal na karne ka hukm aam hai, paida shuda aulaad ko maar dalna bhi isi mamanat mein hai jaise ke Jahiliyat ke zamane wale is khauf se karte the ki unhein kahan se khilayenge pilayenge, aur hamal ka gira dena bhi isi mamanat mein hai khwah is tarah ho ke aise ilaaj kiye jayen jis se hamal thehar hi nahi ya thehre hue hamal ko kisi tarah gira diya jaye.

Buri gharz waghera se, buhtan na baandhne ka ek matlab toh Hazrat Ibn Abbas ne yeh bayan farmaya hai ki dusre ki aulaad ko apne khawand ke sar chipka dena, Abu Daud ki hadith mein hai ki Mulaana ki ayat ke nazil hone ke waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ne farmaya jo aurat kisi qaum mein use dakhil kare jo us qaum ka nahi woh Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek kisi ginti shumar mein nahi aur jo shakhs apni aulaad se inkar kar jaye halanki woh uske samne maujood ho Allah Ta'ala usse aar kar lega aur tamam aglon pichlon ke samne use ruswa o zaleel karega, Huzoor ﷺ ki nafarmani na karein yani aapke ahkaam baja layein aur aapke mana kiye hue kamon se ruk jaya karein, yeh shart yani maroof hone ki aurton ke liye Allah Ta'ala ne laga di hai, Hazrat Maimoon farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne apne Nabi ﷺ ki itaat bhi faqat maroof mein rakhi hai aur maroof hi taaat hai, Hazrat Ibn Zaid farmate hain dekh lo ki behtareen khalq Rasulullah ﷺ ki farmanbardari ka hukm bhi maroof mein hi hai, is baiyat wale din Anhazoor ﷺ ne aurton se noha na karne ka ikrar bhi liya tha jaise Hazrat Umme Atiya ki hadith mein pehle guzar chuka, Hazrat Qatadah farmate hain humse zikr kiya gaya hai. Is baiyat mein yeh bhi tha ki auratein ghair mehramon se baat cheet na karein, is par Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Auf ne farmaya Rasulullah ﷺ basa auqat aisa bhi hota hai ki hum ghar par maujood nahi hote aur mehmaan aa jate hain Aap ne farmaya meri murad unse baat cheet karne ki mamanat se nahi main unse kaam ki baat karne se nahi rokta (Ibn Jarir) Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ne is baiyat ke mauqe par aurton ko namahram mardon se baatein karne se mana farmaya aur farmaya baaz log woh bhi hote hain ki parai aurton se baatein karne mein hi maza liya karte hain yahan tak ki mazi nikal jati hai upar hadith bayan ho chuki hai ki noha na karne ki shart par ek aurat ne kaha falan qabeele ki aurton ne mera sath diya hai toh unke nohe mein main bhi unka sath de kar badla zaroor utarungi chanacha woh gayin badla utara phir aa kar Huzoor ﷺ se baiyat ki.

Hazrat Umme Sulaim jin ka naam un auraton mein hai jinhon ne nauha na karne ki bay'at ko poora kiya, yeh Malhan ki beti aur Hazrat Anas ki walida hain aur riwayat mein hai ke jis aurat ne badle ke nauhe ki ijazat mangi thi khud Huzoor ﷺ ne use ijazat di thi, yehi woh ma'roof hai jis mein nafarmani mana hai. Bay'at karne wali auraton mein se aik ka bayan hai ke ma'roof mein hum Huzoor ﷺ ki nafarmani na karein, is se matlab yeh hai ke museebat ke waqt munh na nochwayen, baal na mundwayen, kapde na phaadein, haye waye na karein. Ibn-e-Jarir mein Hazrat Umme Atiyyah se marwi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ hamare haan Madina mein tashreef laye to aik din Aap ne hukum diya ke sab Ansariyah auratein falan ghar mein jama hon, phir Hazrat Umar bin Khattab ko wahan bheja, Aap darwaze par khade ho gaye aur salam kiya, hum ne Aap ke salam ka jawab diya, phir farmaya main Rasool Allah ﷺ ka qasid hon, hum ne kaha Rasool Allah ko bhi marhaba ho aur Aap ke qasid ko bhi. Hazrat Umar ne farmaya mujhe hukum hua hai ke main tumhein hukum karoon ke tum Allah Ta'ala ke sath shareek na karne par, chori aur zina-kari se bachne par bay'at karo, hum ne kaha hum sab hazir hain aur iqraar karti hain, chunancha Aap ne wahin baher khade khade apna hath andar ki taraf badha diya aur hum ne apne hath andar se baher andar hi andar badhaye. Phir Aap ne farmaya Ae Allah gawah reh. Phir hukum hua ke dono eidoin mein hum apni khanzah auraton aur jawan kunwari larkiyon ko le jaya karein, hum par Jumuma farz nahin, hamein janazon ke sath na jana chahiye. Hazrat Ismail rawi-e-hadith farmate hain main ne apni dadi sahiba Umme Atiyyah se poocha ke auratein ma'roof mein Huzoor ﷺ ki nafarmani na karein is se kya matlab hai? Farmaya yeh ke nauha na karein. Bukhari o Muslim mein hai ke jo koi museebat ke waqt apne galon par thappar mare, daman chaak kare aur jahiliyat ke waqt ki haye o waye machaye woh hum mein se nahi. Aur riwayat mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ us se baree hain jo gala phaad phaad kar haye waye kare, baal noche ya mundwaye aur kapde phaade ya daman cheere. Abu Ali mein hai ke meri ummat mein chaar kaam jahiliyat ke hain jinhein woh na chhodenge: hasab nasab par fakhar karna, insan ko us ke nasab ka taana dena, sitaron se barish talab karna aur mayyat par nauha karna. Aur farmaya nauha karne wali aurat agar baghair tauba kiye mar jaye to use Roz-e-Qayamat gandhak ka pairahan pehnaya jayega aur khujli ki chadar udhayi jayegi. Muslim Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ ne nauha karne waliyon par aur nauhe ko kaan laga kar sunne waliyon par laanat farmayi. Ibn-e-Jarir ki aik marfoo' hadith mein hai ke ma'roof mein nafarmani na karne se murad nauha na karna hai, yeh hadith Tirmizi ki Kitab-ut-Tafsir mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmizi Rahimahullah ise Hasan Gharib kehte hain.

Kufaar se dili dosti ki mمانعت (mumaanat) is surat ki ibtida mein jo hukm tha wohi intiha mein bayaan ho raha hai ke Yahood-o-Nasara aur digar kufaar se jin par Allah ka ghazab aur uski laanat utar chuki hai aur Allah ki rahmat aur uski shafqat se door ho chuke hain tum unse dostana aur mail milap na rakho, woh aakhirat ke sawab se aur wahan ki naimaton se aise na-umeed ho chuke hain jaise qabron wale kaafir. Is pichhle jumle ke do maani kiye gaye hain: ek to yeh ke jaise zinda kaafir apne murda kaafaron ke dobara zinda hone se mayoos ho chuke hain, doosre yeh ke jis tarah murda kaafir har bhalai se na-umeed ho chuke hain woh mar kar aakhirat ke ahwaal dekh chuke aur ab unhein kisi qism ki bhalai ki tawaqqa nahi rahi. Alhamdulillah Surah Mumtahinah ki tafseer khatam hui.
